newsitem.title: USA: NFL-WOMAN WHO ACCUSED COWBOYS STARS MAY BE LYING, HUSBAND SAYS.
newsitem.headline: NFL-WOMAN WHO ACCUSED COWBOYS STARS MAY BE LYING, HUSBAND SAYS.

text.p: The estranged husband of a woman who accused Dallas Cowboys stars Michael Irvin and Erik Williams of sexually assaulting her at gunpoint has told The Dallas Morning News he doubts she is telling the truth.
The husband told the newspaper that his estranged wife, whose name has not been released, had twice falsely accused men of sexual assault in the past.

"It seems very reasonable that she is making this up," the man said. He said he did not have first-hand knowledge of the alleged assault involving the Cowboys players but that the woman was "very melodramatic."

The newspaper, however, also said two friends of the woman have no doubt that she was sexually assaulted. They said they consoled the woman after the alleged attack and described her as bruised, distraught and fearful.
The 23-year-old woman alleged that Irvin held a gun against her head while Williams and another man raped her inside Williams's Dallas home last Sunday night.
No charges have yet been filed but police said they expect to interview Irvin, Williams and the unidentified third man.
Irvin has flatly denied the allegations. He said he was not at Williams's home and was anxious to speak to police.
"I am looking forward to helping and cooperating in any way I can," Irvin told reporters Wednesday.
Williams has so far refused to comment on the allegations.

The Cowboys are preparing for a second-round playoff game against the Carolina Panthers on Sunday. They are the reigning Super Bowl champions, and both Irvin and Williams have played a key role in the team's three Super Bowl victories over the last four years.

Irvin is currently on probation after last year pleading no contest to felony cocaine possession charges. If he is arrested on aggravated sexual assault charges, he could have his probation revoked and be sent to jail.
